кутак баш.definition:
The most popular Tatar swear word which [literally] means "dickhead" but can be used in many other [different] meanings such as "dumbass", "bastard", "moron", "stupidhead".

[Pronounced] as "koo-TAHk-bAHsh"
кутак баш.example:
1) Кутагыма син башымны сегәсең, кутак баш, беләт?
[Translation] from Tatar: Why the hell are you [disturbing] the f*ck out of me, [you dumbass], blyat?
